raw_comment:
JH I noticed that almost everywhere in New York has a drought condition. A lot of the United States has a lot of bad drought. You can drink more soda to save water.

TT If there's a drought, people may have to move to places without a drought. To conserve water. take quicker showers and don't leave the water running when you brush your teeth. 

JQ It's important to save up on water. Fill up your bathtub with water. Get bottled water. You can use plastic plates or paper plates so that you don't have to use water washing dishes.
